//: SECURITY HEADERS — authoritative for PRODUCTION. These must be kept in sync with the `preview.headers` block in vite.config.ts (which only affects `npm run preview` locally; this file is what Vercel actually serves). style-src intentionally keeps 'unsafe-inline': Recharts sets inline style attributes directly on the SVG elements it renders, so removing it would break every chart. script-src pins the exact sha256 of the inline theme script in index.html (which runs before paint to prevent a light/dark flash); if that script changes, recompute the hash or the script will be blocked.

headers.value: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'sha256-w+4wxkZP0NeNriDhqwD41AMWdbQ0lhbfMZIaqWVrBR4='; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'; upgrade-insecure-requests
